== Loops.counting (line 2)
| int counting(int n)
  instruction
    | int sum = 0;
  for style=FREETEXT
    | for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
    -
      instruction
        | sum += i;
  for style=FREETEXT
    | for (int i = 0; i <= n; i += 2)
    -
      instruction
        | sum += i;
  for style=FREETEXT
    | for (int i = n; i > 0; i--)
    -
      instruction
        | sum -= i;
  jump
    | return sum

== Loops.free (line 16)
| int free(int n)
  instruction
    | int sum = 0;
  for style=FREETEXT
    | for (int i = 0, j = n; i < j; i++, j--)
    -
      instruction
        | sum += j - i;
  instruction
    | int i = 0;
  forever
    -
      alternative
        | i > n
        -
          jump
            | break
        -
      instruction
        | i++;
  jump
    | return sum

== Loops.enhanced (line 29)
| int enhanced(int[] values)
  instruction
    | int sum = 0;
  for style=FREETEXT
    | for (int v : values)
    -
      instruction
        | sum += v;
  jump
    | return sum

== Loops.whileLoop (line 37)
| int whileLoop(int n)
  while
    | n > 10
    -
      instruction
        | n = n / 2;
  jump
    | return n

== Loops.doWhile (line 44)
| int doWhile(int n)
  repeat
    | !(n > 0)
    -
      instruction
        | n--;
  jump
    | return n

== Loops.endless (line 51)
| void endless()
  forever
    -
      call
        | work();

  forever
    -
